messages.text: He didn't just install a vault in an obelisk. He built an entire obelisk AROUND a vault.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: That's why there's no doors or windows. The whole structure's one big lock.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: That... doesn't sound promising.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Didn't to me either. So I took a trip to Ultimyr University's registrar's office. Found a records clerk with some outstanding debts in Whitespire.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: You paid off all his debts?

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: No. I just told him I was there to COLLECT them. And that bought me this.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: A blueprint.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Balthazar Blackspire might have been crazy. But he wasn't stupid. He built a back door. Almost impossible to find.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: I'll go find it. You three knock on the front door. Create a distraction.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Right. Blake? There IS no front door.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Go knock on the wall where the porch light and the welcome mat are.
Forgeless Blade

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Brother, you're shaking. You should give Hero an item before you fall over.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Yes, right. Here, take this, Hero. The Forgeless Blade.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: I'm getting close to seeing the bottom of my bottomless bag of holding. We have to get to that vault.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Almost there, brother. Come on. Showtime.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Knock knock!
CREAK!

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: WHO GOES THERE!

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: No, I'm kidding. Name's Griffin Galdron. I'm the sorcerer around here. You guys Klephari?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Well, uh... myself and my... sister... is.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: How about that. I've never seen you guys around here. Usually the villagers chase you out of town.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Aheheh. They do chase us out of town.
Hivestalkers

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: So sorry to bother you at this hour, Sir... uh, Galdron, was it?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Please. Sir Galdron's my father's name, he's buried in my mausoleum.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Oh, I'm so sorry.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: No, don't be. I murdered him. Call me Griff, get in here, it's freezing out.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Is it just the three of you, by the way? Could've sworn I counted four from Koi Pond Seven.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Oh, no no no! No. It's just the three of us.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Also, we— it's late. We should leave.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: No, please stay. Stay FOREVER! I'm kidding. MAYBE forever, though, I haven't decided yet.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: I haven't had anyone visit the obelisk in — jeez, what's it been, five? Six years?

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Oh my...

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: No, I lie. What am I talking about, the city watch was here a few months ago.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Oh. My.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: That's right. I had to fill out a missing artifacts report.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Oh, you don't say.  How... terrible.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Oh, that's kind of you to say. A Klephari and a human broke into my mausoleum. Stole my portrait ward, killed my water golem, pried the artifacts off my ancestors...

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Well... I hope they... catch them.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Here! Hero. Take these hivestalkers. We can talk about how GOOD they look on you later. This is a bad time.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Thank you, that means a lot. Also, this is funny, you're going to appreciate this... but I couldn't help but notice you just handed one of my stolen artifacts to your pet human there.
Queen's Carcanet

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: WHAT? Ah ha ha ha. You think I stole your items and I'M handing them to Hero here?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: You're right. I do think that. I AM thinking that.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: And you're sure you're not just mistaking your PRICELESS artifacts for these WORTHLESS HUMDRUM artifacts I've owned for years... that I'm handing to Hero here?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Don't listen to me. They ARE priceless and he's NOT mistaken.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Here, take this Queen's Carcanet, Hero. I stole it from a mausoleum.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: You know... hearing you explain it like that... now I'm actually MORE convinced that you stole those from me.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: DAMN your curse, brother, you're going to get us all killed.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: ... You know, Galdron...

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Please. Griff.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Griff. It's very dark in this windowless obelisk... Those really could be ANYONE'S Queen's Carcanets...

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: That's fair, yes. They COULD be. How I'm certain they're mine is I watched him steal them through my koi pond.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: I don't see how.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Yes, we were talking about this earlier. Wouldn't you only be able to look straight up at the sky?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: It reflects at an angle. Look, it's FINE. You're Klephari. You STEAL things.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Aheh. We do.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: You've got us there, we love it.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: You know what? You two are so adorable... I'm BARELY beside myself with rage.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Also, don't take this the wrong way, but I'm going to cast a spell that locks the door behind you.
Amber Unguis
ZAP!

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: There. Now nobody's going anywhere. Did you want to give your pet human something else you STOLE from me?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Honestly, yes. Thank you.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Ah. No, it's fine. Curse, right?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: It IS! How did you KNOW?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Well, you seem like a terrible person. You'd never give something away if you didn't have to.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Sister, isn't he perceptive? That's VERY impressive, Griff!

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Wait a minute... Morkaal the Sleepless cursed you, right? Bottom of a dungeon? A thousand beaks and mouths?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: That's him exactly! You KNOW him?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Do I know him — I TAUGHT him that curse!

messages.speaker: Quartero & Quintessa
messages.text: Ha ha ha ha ha ha! Ahhhh...

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: It's a small realm.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: It really is. Ah, that's an Amber Unguis, by the way, Hero. My great grandfather's.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Here, let me give you the tour. It's sort of a gauntlet-claw. That's real gold resin in the talon part there.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Anyway, why don't we get out of this hallway, I would LOVE a hot cocoa before I kill you.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: And I'd love to kill you in a tiled area with running water and a grate — you understand. Let's go to the kitchen.
Venomous Vestments

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Is it alright if I give your hero an item?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: I... suppose so.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Oh, thank you. I always like to ask first. Beautiful animal, by the way. Proud square stance, well-muscled haunches...

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Hero's not actually—

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Who's a good girl? Who's a good girl? Here you go, little guy! Yeah!

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: They're scaled gold-plated shoulder guards, yes they are! YES THEY ARE!

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Hero's not actually my PET, Griff.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Really? Doesn't say anything and follows you around and you feed it treats though, huh?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Who's a good girl?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Well... yes.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: You know what, we're probably saying the same thing. Here's the kitchen, let me get the water on for the cocoa and find a sharp knife for stabbing and killing you.
Venomous Vizard

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Hero, please, take these. What's mine is yours. This is the Venomous Vizard. Sculpted face guards, inlaid jewels.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: And pried off the face of my great-uncle sorcerer Paladir the Cruel by your owner here.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Speaking of which: Who wants cocoa? I hope someone does or it's right to the killing, I'm afraid.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: I'd... like some cocoa, Griff. Also, while we're on the subject, you don't actually HAVE to kill us.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Ha! Oh, that's kind of you to say. No, I'm not OBLIGATED to, obviously, I WANT to.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: I'm an ancient evil in human form. Causing suffering is literally what I do.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Using magic, usually, but I don't have my wand on me, so in this case, a lot of stabbing.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Also, we're splitting hairs here, but when I said earlier that I'd kill you, was it clear I meant through torture?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: It wasn't, no.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Well, good thing I circled back then, because I ABSOLUTELY meant through torture.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Oh! I'm glad we cleared that up.
Venomous Varn

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Oh, would you look at that, the fire went out. No cocoa then. Let me see what else I have. Hmmm. Water, it looks like. Anyone?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: No, I wouldn't blame you there. It's well water too, I.. I usually like to boil it first. I suppose that's not going to matter...

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: You know what, though? I'd really like a hot stove for that torture later. I'm going to go get some wood.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Don't go anywhere! I'm kidding, you're trapped here forever. Until I kill you! Alright, I'll be right back.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: He's gone. Here, take this quick. It's the Venomous Varn. Inlaid jewels in a carapace of—

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Brother, can this wait? We need to get out of here before he kills us!

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: No one's leaving. Where's Galdron?

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Oh, Blake. Thank the gods. He's just left the room for a moment for firewood so he can torture us to death with fire.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Good.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: I— IS that good?

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Let me find a weapon. Stay here in the kitchen and keep distracting him.
Venomous Verdicts

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: OK, I've got the firewood.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Ohp! I've also got something in my back, it feels like... is that a wand of withering?

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: I don't know what it is. I just grabbed it off your desk.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Which desk? The one in the foyer? That'd be the withering, I was varnishing it yesterday. Is there a little woody knot near the handle?

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Hold on, let me, ah...

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Uh, yeah.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Great. Don't put your thumb on that, that'll shoot a withering spell into my spine.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Take me to your vault and I won't have to.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: That's a good idea, I was just going to suggest it. Can I put this firewood down first?

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Go ahead.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Thank you. Oh. Could I also grab my staff— my walking staff? Walking STICK, I mean to say. These... ohhh, these old bones...

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: No weapons.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: I completely understand. Out of curiosity, if I'd just called it my walking stick would you have let me have it?

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Move!
Virulent Vestments

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Here you go, Hero. The Virulent Vestments.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Ugh, I still feel TERRIBLE. Why isn't it WORKING?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Oh, I can help you there. The obelisk is a curse amplifier. It's pretty fascinating, actually. Every curse has a natural entropic bleed — what we call the Balefire Dissipation Constant, or BDC, you know what a BDC is. That's why I introduced a four-plane taper, it gives you that vertical shear you want in the hex-field, I'm not boring you, am I?

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: You are. Shut up.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: We're here. Quartero, say the spell.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Blake, I'm... I'm actually not feeling great here...

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: So say the spell! We're at the VAULT, Quartero. There's enough priceless item sets in there to give away from now till the end of time, just say the gods-damn WORDS.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: MASCUS... PARIAH... BARATO... FATUM!

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Nothing happened. Blake? Why did nothing happen?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Yeah, that's an old password. Why don't I just give you the new one? It's vault one two three four.
CREAK!

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Mountains. There's MOUNTAINS of gold in here!

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: From every epoch! I'm a bit of a coin collector.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: This is... a thousand times more than I was expecting...

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Quartero, give me your bag of holding!

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Blake?

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Shut up. Wait. What.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: If you're shovelling gold into Quartero's bag of holding...

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Who's holding Galdron at wandpoint?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: No one, I'm afraid.
Virulent Vizard

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: You need... to... give Hero... an item... or I'll die.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Why? Oh right, your curse. So if I just give Hero here this headpiece, you'll feel better?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Ah! INSTANTLY.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: How about that. Did you want me to just get rid of that curse, by the way?

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: You can DO that?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: I mean... I invented the curse, I don't see why not. Here.
ZAP!

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Oh...gods! FINALLY! My bone marrow! My bone marrow feels GREAT!

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: And my GREED! Oh oh, I feel GREEDY again! I — oh no!

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: [sobbing]

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Why the hell is he crying? You lifted the curse.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: I'm... I'm also confused.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: I'm just thinking of all the priceless item sets I've GIVEN this idiot for FREE! It's KILLING ME just thinking about it!

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: I see. Look, um... I'm going to need you to stop crying.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: [sobbing]

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Everybody is embarrassed. It would mean a lot to all of us if you stopped.
Virulent Varn

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: I can't help but notice you're still sobbing like a child, and it's not getting less embarrassing over time.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: I'm sorry. I'm just... so happy I don't have to give this idiot free item sets anymore.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Hero, take this tailpiece. It's yours. You earned it. Heh. Not really. Take it anyway.

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Wait, Galdron, stop! Sell it to them instead! At a five hundred percent mark—

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Oh, alright. It does look good on them.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: You never know, brother! Maybe you'll start giving Hero item sets WITHOUT the curse!

messages.speaker: Quartero
messages.text: Heh. Oh, that is... the stupidest thing you've ever said, sister.
Toxic Tribunal

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Now. Both of you get in the vault.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Us? You mean me and Blake Sextus?

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Why do you want us in there?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Because I'm locking you in it. Just till I get back with Hero and Quartero here. There's something I need them to do for me.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Could we have food? So we don't... you know, starve to death?

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Of course. Let me just lock you in there and I'll be RIGHT back with a BIG feast for you both. Heh heh heh.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: Hm. You were chuckling evilly when you said that.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Was I?

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: You were. It makes it difficult to trust what you're saying.

messages.speaker: Sextus
messages.text: Yeah, I don't believe you.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: That's fair. No, I assure you the offer was entirely genuine. Let me just lock you in this vault and I'll be back before you know it.

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Heh heh heh.

messages.speaker: Quintessa
messages.text: You're doing it a—
SLAM!

messages.speaker: Galdron
messages.text: Right. You two ready? Why am I asking? You don't have a choice. Come on, I'll explain on the way.
